name: 1-5 Khartoum Road Data Centre

address.note: 10,015 sqm site (Part Lot 2 DP 1043041) replacing a two-storey car park; MPark Stage 2

postcode.note: suburb postcode (Australia Post); not stated in source

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 1 Khartoum Road (site is 1-5)

developer.note: applicant (Notice of Decision); developed via 50:50 JV with EdgeConneX (w.media); datacentermap lists as EdgeConneX Macquarie Park SYD1

mw_it.note: Assessment Report Table 1: 'Maximum power capacity 76.4 MW (51.4 MW IT Load)'; EIS: '76.4 MVA (total power), 51.4 MW (IT Load)'

mw_grid.note: total power capacity; 24 data halls, 28 x 3MW generators. The portal description still reads 'capacity of 35 MW' (apparently outdated)

cost_aud_m.note: estimated development cost $718,259,656 (Assessment Report). The Notice of Decision says 'investment of $781 million' - apparently a transposition of $718m

authority.note: Minister for Planning and Public Spaces consent authority; granted by A/Director under delegation

lodged.note: approximate: EIS (Urbis) dated 17 Feb 2025 and uploaded that day; exhibited 6 Mar-2 Apr 2025. Earlier value 'Dec 2024' came from a secondary summary (Dec 2024 was pre-lodgement: BDAR waiver 5 Dec 2024, Council meeting 5 Dec 2024)

determined.note: Notice of Decision and portal Determination Date 11/03/2026

jobs_construction.note: Assessment Report (citing the draft CTMP): 'construction worker numbers will vary during the construction program with a maximum of 250 workers during peak periods and a minimum of 50 workers anticipated during non-peak'

jobs_construction_other.note: Assessment Report / Notice of Decision: 'up to 250 full-time equivalent construction jobs'; EIS: 'up to 250 full-time equivalent (FTE) jobs during construction' - no period defined
CTMP minimum on-site workforce: 'a minimum of 50 workers anticipated during non-peak'

jobs_operational.note: EIS: '50 FTE jobs once operational' / 'approximately 50 full time employees once fully operational'; Assessment Report: '50 operational jobs'

construction_start.note: projected FY2027 (datacentermap); construction expected to take 33 months (Assessment Report)

open_questions: builder and construction start not announced

related: separate SSD-80814238 'Road 1 Data Centre' (Stockland, 34.3MW, 10 storeys, directly south on the same lot) is a different building still under assessment (More Information Required) - not a duplicate; add to list if approved
